confirmation_source: author correction of original experimental records for the 98 measured samples
warming_procedure: allow the original sealed package to reach room temperature with no external condensation before opening; avoid repeated opening and freeze-thaw cycles
measurement_sequence: representative ground portion of the same sample
sieve_procedure: regrind all retained material until the entire portion passes; discard no component
grinding_temperature_control: control temperature rise and moisture loss; mix and promptly seal the powder; measure after temperature stabilises
sample_cup_filling: fully cover the measurement window with optically opaque sample depth, consistent filling height and packing; naturally level without deliberate compression
instrument_checks: reference correction with the instrument internal high-reflectance standard
aggregation: wavelength-wise arithmetic mean of the two independently repacked, internally averaged spectra
reflectance_definition: dimensionless corrected diffuse reflectance relative to the instrument reference, represented as a fraction
legacy_replicate_column_meaning: single exported mean-spectrum record index; value 1 does not count the underlying acquisition repackings
